story_title: As an Event Coordinator, I want to review a submitted event request so that I can determine whether sufficient information is available to proceed with planning

acceptance_criteria.text: The Event Coordinator can view submitted event requests they are authorised to review.
All relevant event requirements are displayed.
The Event Coordinator can identify incomplete or unclear information.
The Event Coordinator can approve the request for planning.
The Event Coordinator can reject the request.
The event status is updated according to the review outcome.

test_cases.title: Review page displays all requirements of the request
test_cases.preconditions:
Test data loaded: `npm run fixtures:spm28` has been run from the project folder since the last full `npx prisma db seed` (it only touches the 'SPM28 …' events, EVT-000124 to EVT-000130, never anyone else's data).

test_cases.test_data: Event: SPM28 Nusantara Product Launch (EVT-000124) | Client: Nusantara Tech Labs | Organiser: Sari Widodo | Category: Exhibition | Purpose: Regional product launch and press event | Description: Press event with livestream and product demonstration area. | When: 17 Mar 2027, 15:00–19:00 | Expected attendance: 200 | Preferred layout: Theatre | Registration: Not enabled | Facilities: High-density WiFi (required), Raised stage (required), Livestream capability (required), Green room (nice-to-have) | Equipment: LED Video Wall Panel × 4, Streaming Encoder × 1 | Accessibility needs and Special requirements: left empty by the organiser
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 1: The Review Queue page opens and lists 'SPM28 Nusantara Product Launch'.
Step 2: The 'Review request' page opens, with 'SPM28 Nusantara Product Launch' under the title and the 'Under review' badge. The 'What was requested' card shows every value in the test data next to its label, each facility followed by '(required)' or '(nice-to-have)', and each equipment item as 'name × quantity'. Accessibility needs and Special requirements show a 'Not provided' marker. No raw stored values (e.g. 'under_review', 'theatre') are shown.

test_cases.title: Coordinator approves a request for planning
test_cases.preconditions:
Test data loaded: `npm run fixtures:spm28` has been run from the project folder since the last full `npx prisma db seed` (it only touches the 'SPM28 …' events, EVT-000124 to EVT-000130, never anyone else's data).
Before: run `npm run fixtures:spm28` so 'SPM28 Harbourline Client Seminar' is back to Under review.
Logged in as Daniel Tan (daniel.tan@connectsphere.com / password123), coordinator of 'SPM28 Harbourline Client Seminar' (Under review).
After: run `npm run fixtures:spm28` so the next tester starts from the same state. It deletes and recreates only the 'SPM28 …' events - do NOT run `npx prisma db seed`, which wipes everyone's data.
steps: Click 'All Events' in the sidebar and open 'SPM28 Harbourline Client Seminar'
test_cases.test_data: Event: SPM28 Harbourline Client Seminar (EVT-000125) | Outcome: Approve
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 2: The 'Review request' page opens with the 'Under review' badge.
Step 3: The option is highlighted and an 'Approve request' button is shown.
Step 4: A dialog 'Approve this request?' appears, saying the event moves from Under review to Approved. The status has not changed yet.
Step 5: A green 'Request approved' alert reads '"SPM28 Harbourline Client Seminar" is now Approved. Planning can start.' The status badge changes from 'Under review' to 'Approved' and the 'Your decision' card disappears.
Step 6: 'SPM28 Harbourline Client Seminar' is no longer listed.
Step 7: The event page shows the 'Approved' status badge, and no 'This request is waiting for your review' alert.

open_questions: RESOLVED 2026-09-30: The review page shows 'Under review' (SPM-30 behaviour), not 'Submitted' as in the EventReview mockup. The mockup needs updating.
RESOLVED 2026-09-30: Approving moves the event to 'Approved'. SPM-54 moves it on to 'Planning'.

RESOLVED 2026-09-30: Incomplete information is flagged only ('Not provided' markers and a summary alert) and never blocks Approve. Per discussion #80, approval means there is sufficient information for planning, and that is the coordinator's judgment; per #72, mandatory fields are not defined.

RESOLVED 2026-09-30: Clarifications are out of scope for SPM-28 - neither raising them ('Ask the organiser for clarification' in the mockup) nor showing existing ones. AC3 is met by flagging fields that were not provided.
RESOLVED 2026-09-30: No organiser notification on approve/reject in SPM-28.
RESOLVED 2026-09-30: The organiser sees the rejection reason in a red banner at the top of the event Overview ('This request was rejected' + reason).
RESOLVED 2026-09-30: Approve requires a confirmation dialog (tested in TC08 and TC09).
RESOLVED 2026-09-30: The server will only allow approve/reject from 'Under review'. Not reachable from the UI, so no manual test case; cover it with a unit test.

RESOLVED 2026-09-30: Test data. Every case uses the 'SPM28 …' events from `npm run fixtures:spm28` (scripts/seed-spm28.ts), which deletes and recreates only those events - never a full `npx prisma db seed`. TC08 and TC10 change data; their preconditions say to run it before and after. The same events are in prisma/seed.ts, so a full reseed also includes them.

RESOLVED 2026-09-30: Opening the review page of a request that is no longer Under review redirects to the event page (TC15), instead of showing a 'Nothing to review' message. A coordinator who is not assigned still sees 'You can't review this request' (TC03).
